name: Feedback
description: In-app feedback widget that files a GitHub issue and hands the issue off to a local-runner Claude triage loop (PR-always; large changes need human approval).

routes.description: Submit feedback -> create GitHub issue -> emit triage handoff.

FEEDBACK_GITHUB_TOKEN.title: GitHub token
FEEDBACK_GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Token with `repo` / `issues` scope on the target repository.

FEEDBACK_GITHUB_REPO.title: Target repository
FEEDBACK_GITHUB_REPO.description: Repository that feedback issues are filed in, as `owner/name`.

FEEDBACK_ISSUE_LABELS.title: Issue labels
FEEDBACK_ISSUE_LABELS.description: Comma-separated labels applied to every created issue.

FEEDBACK_TRIAGE_WEBHOOK_URL.title: Triage webhook URL
FEEDBACK_TRIAGE_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Where the triage handoff is POSTed. If unset, the local runner is expected to poll issues instead.

FEEDBACK_TRIAGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.title: Triage webhook secret
FEEDBACK_TRIAGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Shared secret; the handoff is signed with HMAC-SHA256 in the `X-Polis-Signature` header.

FEEDBACK_LARGE_CHANGE_THRESHOLD.title: Large-change threshold
FEEDBACK_LARGE_CHANGE_THRESHOLD.description: Issue-body length over which a change is flagged `requires_approval` for the triage loop. 0 disables the heuristic.

FEEDBACK_SHARED_SECRET.title: Frontend bearer secret
FEEDBACK_SHARED_SECRET.description: Optional bearer the widget must send to the backend. Injected into both the backend env and the frontend bundle config by the controller.
